title: Longest Palindromic Substring
statement:
Find the longest substring of a string that reads the same forward and backward.

The input is one line of lowercase letters, with at least one letter. A substring is a run of letters that sit next to each other in the string. Print the longest substring that is a palindrome. When several are equally long, print the one that starts first, so `babad` prints `bab` and not `aba`. A single letter is a palindrome on its own, so there is always an answer.

Input:

```text
babad
```

Expected output:

```text
bab
```
hints: Every palindrome has a middle. Try each position as the middle, and grow outward one letter on each side for as long as the two letters match.
A palindrome of odd length, like `aba`, has one letter in the middle. One of even length, like `abba`, has its middle between two letters. Try both kinds at every position.

Remember where the best palindrome starts and how long it is, and replace it only when you find a strictly longer one. Cut it out at the end with a slice or `substring`. In C++, `substr` takes a start and a length, not an end.
